title: 1:1 prep - Samir Desai
content:
Context:
- Weekly 1:1 with Samir (senior backend engineer, platform team). Focus: rollout stability for model routing, latency regression, on-call readiness, and career check-in.
- Recent incidents: small latency spike on routing layer last week (P0 degraded to P1), root cause suspected to be KV cache growth + a bad kernel path for long sequences.

Agenda (30 min):
1) Quick sync (5 min)
   - How are you? energy, bandwidth this sprint
   - Updates since last 1:1
2) Incidents & RCA status (8 min)
   - Where we are on PLT-4823 (routing latency regression)
   - Current hypothesis and experiments run
3) Priorities & blockers (7 min)
   - What needs my help (infra quotas, cross-team alignment)
   - Any slow blockers for ship dates (dedicated rollout)
4) Career / growth (6 min)
   - Interest in leading next on-call rotation as tech lead?
   - Stretch project: kernel selection optimizer prototype
5) Action items & follow-ups (4 min)
   - Confirm owners, timelines, and check-ins

Prep notes (things I want to cover):
- Incident summary: on 2026-02-27 routing p50 increased ~15% for 95th percentile long-seq requests. Error rates unchanged. Degraded customer experience in a small subset (dedicated customers).
- Samir owns the cache eviction prototype and the canary for the new kernel. Need status: did the eviction prototype reduce memory growth in staging?
- PR #879 landed for improved memory accounting but only on canary nodes. Samir to confirm if we can widen canary.
- Jira PLT-4823 shows steps: reproduce -> isolate kernel path -> test eviction patch -> roll forward. Last comment: "need longer run in staging (24h)" (Priya assigned to staging infra).

Questions for Samir:
- What experiments have you run since Friday? Any data (p50/p95, mem usage traces)?
- Do you think KV cache growth is the primary driver vs kernel inefficiency?
- If cache is the cause, what's the risk of enabling eviction in prod? quick rollout plan?
- Do you need a hand pushing staging longer run or manual approval for an expanded canary?
- How are you feeling about owning the on-call rotation next month?

Notes to self (coaching prompts):
- Encourage ownership but avoid overloading: offer to escalate infra quota requests to SRE lead if needed.
- If Samir is hesitant about on-call, propose a co-lead with Priya for first rotation.
- Push on writing a short postmortem doc even if RCA incomplete (helps with cross-team visibility).

Current metrics to review during meeting (have these ready):
- Routing p50/p95 before vs after regression: baseline p95=280ms -> observed p95=320ms for long sequences
- Memory usage in canary: heap + KV cache rose ~18% over 12h in staging run
- Cost impact: estimated +4% compute for affected workload (note: approximate)

Proposed immediate actions (to confirm in 1:1):
- Expand staging run to 48h and wire up extra perf monitors (owner: Priya, ETA: 48h)
- Flip eviction prototype on canary nodes and monitor (owner: Samir, ETA: today end-of-day)
- If eviction reduces memory growth, plan staggered canary widening (owner: Karen + Samir, ETA: 3 days)
- Draft short public postmortem / incident note for console channel (owner: Samir, draft by EOD tomorrow)

Longer-term follow-ups (career & growth + infra):
- Kernel selection optimizer: propose Samir lead a 6-week spike to prototype a heuristic that routes by seq-length distribution (good career stretch).
- On-call readiness: create a short checklist for first-time leads (runbooks, escalation matrix, runbook drills). Offer to pair for first pager.

Action items to capture in meeting (will log after):
- Samir: enable eviction on canary + share perf graphs (due: today EOD)
- Priya: extend staging run to 48h and add mem/alloc traces (due: +48h)
- Karen (me): escalate infra quota if staging nodes needed; schedule 30m deep-dive Thursday with SRE if regression persists (due: tomorrow)
- Samir: draft incident note and short status update for eng-ops (due: tomorrow EOD)

Potential risks / flags:
- If eviction only masks kernel inefficiency, we may see recurrence under different load patterns. Need test plan that includes long-tail seq distributions.
- Customer impact: dedicated customers are sensitive to p95 regressions; coordinate comms with CS if widening canary could show noise.

Meeting wrap script (what I plan to say at end):
- "Thanks - plan here feels tight but doable. If any blocker pops up, ping me immediately and I'll help escalate. I'll follow up with a calendar invite for the deep-dive and update the Jira tasks after this meeting."

Follow-up log (for after meeting) - placeholder to fill:
- Meeting outcome summary: (short bullet)
- Confirmed owners/timelines: (fill)
- New blockers uncovered: (fill)
- Career decision: (fill)

Misc scratchpad (notes-to-self / quick links):
- Slack thread: #platform-routing (recent convo timestamps: Feb 27 - Mar 2)
- PR to watch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/879
- RCA notes: Confluence draft link (I will create after meeting)

Tone notes: keep it supportive, direct, and outcome-oriented. Emphasize learning and safety - we want Samir to take on leadership but not burn out.
